display.purpose: Manrope hero name; mobile uses clamp(2.8rem, 10.5vw, 4.6rem).

title.purpose: Standard project heading; featured and compact exhibition variants have contextual sizes.

body.purpose: Locally hosted Geist prose, navigation and actions. Use the source --font-body variable for its generated family.

label.purpose: Plain wrapping technology list, not a chip or filter.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: HTML scrolling; reduced motion switches to auto.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applies to all elements and pseudo-elements in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Hover transforms remain instantaneous.

components.name: Resume Link
components.description: Outlined anchor for the external resume; 40px minimum height on mobile.
components.html: Resume
components.css: .ds-resume { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 16px; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #bcb3c7; border-radius:6px; color:var(--ink, #27232e); font-family:var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.88rem; font-weight:550; line-height:1.6; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-resume:hover { background:var(--lavender, #ddd2f0); } .ds-resume:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #7650a8); outline-offset:5px; border-radius:2px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-resume { min-height:40px; padding:5px 12px; font-size:.8rem; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-resume { transition:none !important; } }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Direct contact action with underlined hover and directional SVG feedback.
components.html: Get in touch
components.css: .ds-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; min-height:44px; color:var(--ink, #27232e); font-family:var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.94rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1.6; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:.3em; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-link svg { flex-shrink:0; transition:transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-link:hover svg { transform:translate(2px,-2px); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #7650a8); outline-offset:5px; border-radius:2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-link svg { transition:none !important; } }

components.name: Main Navigation
components.description: Always-visible plain links with an active underline; stretches across the mobile header's second row.
components.html: HomeProjectsAboutWriting
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; font-family:var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); line-height:1.6; } .ds-nav a { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--quiet, #645f6e); font-size:.92rem; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color:var(--ink, #27232e); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page]::after { content:''; position:absolute; bottom:4px; left:0; right:0; height:2px; background:var(--violet, #392a50); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #7650a8); outline-offset:5px; border-radius:2px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-nav { width:100%; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; } .ds-nav a { font-size:.84rem; } }

components.name: Technology List
components.description: Actual plain-text metadata pattern; intentionally has no interactive states or pill shape.
components.css: .ds-technologies { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; column-gap:16px; row-gap:4px; margin:19px 0 12px; padding:0; list-style:none; color:var(--quiet, #645f6e); font-family:var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); font-size:.77rem; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Project Image Mat
components.description: Default contained-image frame, not a clickable card. Preview uses the existing owner-supplied project image.
components.css: .ds-project-mat { display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; margin:0; background:#eeeaf3; aspect-ratio:16/10; padding:24px; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-project-mat img { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; max-width:100%; object-fit:contain; object-position:center; }

components.name: Writing Row
components.description: Whole-row article destination with date, heading, divider and color feedback.
components.html:
December 11, 2024

Getting Started with my Blog :)
components.css: .ds-writing-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr auto; gap:32px; align-items:center; padding:36px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #ddd9e4); color:var(--ink, #27232e); font-family:var(--font-body, Geist, sans-serif); line-height:1.6; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-writing-row time { font-size:.87rem; color:var(--quiet, #645f6e); } .ds-writing-row h2 { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-display, Manrope, sans-serif); font-size:1.75rem; font-weight:550; letter-spacing:-.035em; line-height:1.3; text-wrap:balance; } .ds-writing-row:hover { color:#7650a8; } .ds-writing-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #7650a8); outline-offset:5px; border-radius:2px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-writing-row { grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:12px 20px; padding:28px 0; } .ds-writing-row time { grid-column:1/-1; } .ds-writing-row h2 { font-size:1.45rem; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-writing-row { transition:none !important; } }

narrative.overview:
Cool paper, graphite lettering and an ink-violet exhibition field frame real engineering work. Large, left-aligned Manrope headings and quiet Geist copy give the portfolio a precise, open, restrained character for recruiters and technical teams.

Project imagery supplies the visual evidence; the interface supplies alignment, tonal framing and direct routes to source, resume and contact. This records the implemented all-site redesign, not a provisional direction. Surface-specific strategy remains in `.impeccable/surface-home.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper and violet/lavender tonal contrast.
Open layouts with fine dividers and modest image corners.
Real project previews, plain-text metadata and direct navigation.
Still content with brief, directional link feedback.

rules.name: The Contrast Pairing Rule
rules.body: Use quiet graphite on paper and quiet lavender on violet; do not carry light-surface metadata colors onto the exhibition field.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Manrope carries headings and the wordmark; Geist carries prose, navigation, actions and technical metadata.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with color, spacing and fine rules; keep project entries flat at rest and on hover.

dos: Do preserve the paper/graphite and violet/lavender contrast pairings.
Do pair Manrope headings with locally hosted Geist prose and metadata.
Do contain real project imagery inside modestly rounded tonal mats.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, direct destinations and wrapping mobile navigation.
donts: Don't replace project evidence with invented imagery or claims.
Don't add glass tiles, decorative shadows or animated skill grids to this world.
Don't turn technology metadata into interactive pills without a real interaction.
Don't promote local color exceptions or unused compatibility tokens into new global variants.
